author: JerryRigEverything
description:
Its time to expand Not-a-Wheelchair! We launched our Off Road wheelchairs five years ago - and now its time to take things to the next level with Manual Wheelchairs. Try out our Paradox Wheelchair Configurator HERE: https://www.notawheelchair.com/ and HUGE thank you for watching our videos. This factory would not be possible with out your support and help from the community. 

We do sell collectors coins if you want to help out monetarily - https://www.notawheelchair.com/donate 100% of your donation goes towards helping us keep the lights on and make wheelchairs less expensive for the people who need them. Cambry and I don't take any money from this project. 

If you want to know how to measure yourself for a Paradox Wheelchair this is the video for you. You can also check out our Not-a-Wheelchair youtube channel for more information here: @notawheelchair
